text:
jules: quick heads-up  support ticket claims a tenant was billed twice after a stream resume. UI shows provisional row then a separate confirmed row with overlapping token offsets.

maya: can you drop the request/session ids and whether this involved a model fallback or region handoff?

jules: req=rb-223 / sess=ses-7k, region=us-east, fallback to warm pool. client observed early EOF, reconnected, server resumed and replayed 56 tokens.

kevin: pulled trace for ses-7k: 
```
2026-04-20T22:10:01Z ingress: accept req=rb-223 sess=ses-7k provisional_tokens=180
2026-04-20T22:10:05Z runtime: stream-truncate reason=client_eof emitted_prefix=56
2026-04-20T22:10:06Z router: handoff start -> resume target=pool-warm
2026-04-20T22:10:07Z ledger: provisional_insert sess=ses-7k tokens=56 tag=prov-56-a1
2026-04-20T22:10:09Z ledger: confirm_insert sess=ses-7k tokens=56
```

kevin: note we created a prov tag on resume but did not tombstone or link the earlier provisional from the original connection. confirm_insert created a separate confirmed row.

leah: this is similar to other incidents but with a twist  a toolcall fired during resume in a few repros. toolcall TTL logic can also create overlapping provisional entries if toolcall sidecars replay. we should consider provenance at both token-prefix and toolcall levels.

maya: proposal: introduce a short-lived provenance key (prov_key) generated at initial emission for every prefix (req_id + prefix_start). carry prov_key through handoffs and include it on ledger provisional rows. confirm should upsert by prov_key (mark provisional->confirmed) instead of blindly inserting.

jules: agree. additionally, for toolcalls: attach the prov_key to the toolcall invocation and ensure the tool subsystem dedupes retries by prov_key+tool_id. avoids double charges when toolcall results are replayed.

kevin: implementation notes:
- router: generate prov_key = base64(hmac(router_salt, req_id || prefix_start)) on first provisional emission. propagate in handoff RPC.
- ledger: provisional rows store prov_key. confirm endpoint should be confirm_by_prov_key(prov_key, tokens, final=true) which upserts if prov_key exists; fallback to insert if prov_key not present.
- tool subsystem: accept optional prov_key param and idempotency key = prov_key + tool_name.

leah: console UX: show merged row when prov_key present. merged row shows tokens_final and a small "merged provisional+confirm" pill. provide an "expanded" view into raw ledger entries for auditors. short-term: collapse heuristically by session+overlap >60% for 48h window to reduce false alarms before rollout.

maya: telemetry: add these metrics so we can monitor post-rollout regressions:
- billing.prov_key_upsert_total (counter)
- billing.prov_key_conflict_errors (counter)
- billing.toolcall_idempotent_replays (counter with tag tool=name)
- billing.overlap_collapses_console (counter)
also emit a trace tag prov_key on relevant spans.

jules: migration/rollout plan: feature-flag prov_key generation in router; enable ledger upsert behind a flag; deploy console merge read-side optional. Canary in one region for 24-48h; run recon job to detect pre-existing overlapping rows and annotate them.

kevin: tests: unit tests for ledger.confirm_by_prov_key upsert semantics, integration test simulating concurrent handoff+resume where original provisional tombstone races with resume confirm, and an e2e with toolcall replay that ensures single billed invocation. add chaos test for packet drops.

leah: reconciliation: recon service currently expects a provisional->confirm insertion timeline. Make it accept upsert events keyed by prov_key and emit both an audit delta and an "upserted" event to remain backward compatible.

maya: ops-bot: created ticket BILL-2026-310 and alert rule billing.prov_key_conflict_errors > 1/min.

ops-bot: incident created BILL-2026-310, linked to SUP-2026-944, owner=jules.

jules: I'll start a small router PR to generate prov_key and add the handoff proto field. kevin take ledger; leah take toolcall dedupe; maya will own console collapse. we'll keep prov_key off by default so rollback is trivial.

maya: one more UI nit  when we merge rows surface a tiny audit link that expands to raw ledger rows and timestamps so customer support can quickly confirm whether a double-bill actually occurred.

kevin: noted. also we should add a short TTL (72h) index on prov_key in ledger so we don't bloat indexes long-term.

jules: thanks all. paste any other session ids if support finds more examples and i'll correlate.

maya: thanks  plan sounds low-risk and reversible. :thumbsup:
